The work, minus the reading

Four steps, and the tedious one is gone

  1. Drop in the file

    The policy and the denial letter. Or the evaluation and the IEP. Or the itemised bill and the plan documents. Faxed, scanned, photographed, out of order — it does not matter.

  2. It reads everything, then cross-references it

    Not a summary. A comparison. Where does the denial letter contradict the policy it cites? Where does the IEP fail to address a finding in the district's own evaluation? Where is the bill charging for something the plan already covers?

  3. You check the finding against the page

    Every point Countercite raises links to the exact page and passage that produced it. You are reviewing evidence, not trusting a machine — which is the difference between a tool you can sign your name to and one you cannot.

  4. It drafts, you decide

    A letter making your argument, in your house style, with citations. You edit it, you send it, it is your work product and your judgement.

What it actually does

Built around the part of the job that does not scale

The contradiction finder

Across every document in the case at once. This is the part a human does badly at hour six and a machine does identically at hour six hundred.

Every claim cites its page

No assertion appears without a link to the source passage. You can defend any sentence in the letter because you can see where it came from.

The clock

Proof-of-loss windows, appraisal demands, prompt-payment statutes, IDEA timelines, appeal deadlines. Missed deadlines lose cases that were winnable.

Your templates, your voice

It drafts in the format you already use. A tool that makes you sound like someone else creates work rather than removing it.

Nothing is used for training

Client documents produce your work product and nothing else. No training, no sharing, deletion on request.

Outcome tracking from day one

Win rate, dollars recovered, hours per case. We track it because a tool that claims to help you should be able to prove it.

The honest part

What Countercite will not do

It will not represent anyone. It will not negotiate a claim, attend a meeting, sign a filing or give advice. Where your state requires a licence to act for a policyholder or a family, that licence is yours and the responsibility stays with you.

It also will not tell you a case is winnable. It surfaces what the documents say and where they disagree. Deciding what that means is the professional judgement you are paid for, and any product that pretends otherwise is selling you a liability.

In February 2025 the FTC required DoNotPay to pay $193,000 and stop advertising that its service performed like a real lawyer, because it never tested whether it did. We built the outcome tracking first, for that reason.
